title: my_sisters_wedding_gift
beats: I never returned the $4,000 my sister lent me for my wedding (31F).
She wired it three days before the ceremony, no questions asked, because our dad had just passed and I was drowning.
I told her I'd pay her back in six monthly installments starting that August.
August came and went, and so did eleven more Augusts.
Every time she brought it up, gently, I said things were tight and I'd catch up soon.
Meanwhile I redid our kitchen, took two trips to Portugal, leased a car I didn't need.
Last month she asked if she could borrow $4,000 from me for her son's braces.
I said I didn't have it, and I watched her face do the math in real time.
She didn't yell, she just said 'okay' and hung up.
We haven't spoken in nineteen days now.
I keep opening my banking app, looking at a balance that could fix this in one transfer.
I never tell people this part: I never forgot the debt.
I just decided, somewhere along the way, that her kindness was mine to keep.
